- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py | severity=critical | confidence=[5]

  WHY: The implementation under review does not match the claimed PR changes, so review of this checkout would assess the wrong version.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1515-1519 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The env `-S` denial check can miss split strings attached directly to `-S`; the regex also misses commands split by newlines.
  WHY: The check then fails to detect the guarded git subcommand and `_evaluate_bash` can return without merged-PR validation. Highest severity used; Google and OpenAI rated this MAJOR, while GLM rated it BLOCKER.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1515-1519 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The env `-S` denial check can miss split strings attached directly to `-S` or commands split by newlines.
  WHY: The check then fails to detect the guarded git subcommand and `_evaluate_bash` can return without merged-PR validation. Highest severity used; Google and OpenAI rated this MAJOR, while GLM rated it BLOCKER.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:429-433, 858-862, 1528-1530 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The env parsers can mistake the `git` value of GNU env’s `-a`/`--argv0` option for the executable and fail to recognize the actual `push` subcommand.
  WHY: `git_subcommands` can then return no guarded subcommand, causing `_evaluate_bash` to return without merged-PR validation.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:429-433, 858-862, 1528-1530 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The env parsers can mistake the `git` value of GNU env’s `-a`/`--argv0` option for the executable and fail to recognize the actual `push` subcommand.
  WHY: `git_subcommands` can then return no guarded subcommand, causing `_evaluate_bash` to return without merged-PR validation.

  PROBLEM: The original security bug reported in issue #6336 remains unfixed. Inline git configuration (`-c remote.main.url=...`, `-c push.default=current`) can still redirect a push to bypass the merged-PR guard because the working tree does not contain any of the inline-config resolution, `env` prefix parsing, or blocking logic described in the PR diff.
  WHY: `git -c remote.main.url=https://github.com/o/r.git -c push.default=current push main` pushes the current branch to the inline-defined remote. The guard's existing parser resolves neither the inline config nor the selected remote and checks the wrong branch, allowing a push from a merged feature branch.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1515-1519 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The env -S denial regex `re.search(r"\bgit\b.*\b(?:push|commit)\b", " ".join(tokens[index + 1:]))` fails for a split string attached directly to `-S` or for commands containing newlines.
  WHY: When the regex fails, the env -S early-denial block does not trigger; downstream, `git_subcommands` fails to extract git and push, and `_evaluate_bash` allows the command without merged-PR status validation.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1515-1519 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5

  WHY: When the regex fails, the env -S early-denial block does not trigger; downstream, `git_subcommands` fails to extract git and push, and `_evaluate_bash` allows the command without merged-PR status validation.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:429-433, 858-862, 1528-1530 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The loops scanning past an unrecognized env option stop at the first token named `git`; an option argument such as the argv0 value in `env -a git` or `env --argv0 git` can therefore be mistaken for the executable.
  WHY: `git_subcommands` records `git` instead of `push` or `commit`, so `guarded_git_subcommands` is empty and `_evaluate_bash` returns before the guarded invocation is checked.
